newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BAYERN STILL WAITING FOR ELBER'S ANSWER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN STILL WAITING FOR ELBER'S ANSWER.

text.p: Bayern Munich are still waiting for VfB Stuttgart's prolific Brazilian forward Giovane Elber to respond to their contract offer, club president Franz Beckenbauer said.
Bayern had made no secret of their interest in Elber, who has failed to agree terms with Stuttgart beyond the end of next season and now wants to move when this season is over.
"Elber has received our contract offer," Beckenbauer told Friday's edition of the daily Bild. "He has said he doesn't want to stay on at Stuttgart but he hasn't approached us yet."

Beckenbauer said he believed a number of Spanish clubs might also have shown interest in Elber, who says he wants to join a top club to boost his chances of playing for Brazil in next year's World Cup finals.
Beckenbauer dismissed the idea Bayern would be more likely to release Germany striker Juergen Klinsmann if they signed Elber.
"The two things have nothing to do with each other," he said. "We want them both."
Klinsmann has struggled to find form this season and toyed with the idea of leaving unless Bayern, the league leaders at the winter break, make their playing style more attractive.
